changeSet.author: bilous
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO answer_option (question_id, content, is_correct) SELECT qn.id, 'Option ' + CAST(v.value AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' for Q' + CAST(qn.id AS VARCHAR(10)), CASE WHEN v.value = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM question qn CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 4) v WHERE qn.prompt LIKE 'Mock Question %';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM answer_option WHERE content LIKE 'Option % for Q%';
